test_inspect_string_documentation: run the String test case to verify m.css generates correct HTML docs from string-based module inspection
test_inspect_object_documentation: run the Object test case to verify m.css generates identical HTML docs when inspecting live module objects
test_inspect_annotations: run the Annotations test case to verify m.css correctly documents type-annotated classes and functions across Python versions
test_create_intersphinx_inventory: run the CreateIntersphinx test case to verify m.css generates a valid Sphinx intersphinx inventory file from inspected modules
test_inspect_type_links: run the TypeLinks test case to verify m.css generates correct cross-references and type links in generated documentation
